$comment: Provider-neutral template (RC97): no if/then/oneOf, which vendor strict modes reject. `outputSchemaFor` (src/prompts/templates.ts) builds the schema sent with each request from the spread: the `<positionId>` property of `cards` becomes one required property per position ID of the spread, and `prompt<n>` of `reflectionPrompts` becomes prompt1..promptN (the spread's count), so the grammar enforces both counts without minItems/maxItems, which some vendor strict modes reject. The Worker's zod parse (parseModelOutput) also requires, when classification is none, a non-empty title, overview, synthesis, interpretation and prompt, and the drawn cardId and reversed echoed per position.

classification.description: Decided first. "none" = write the reading; any other value = refusal, every other string empty.

title.description: Two to seven words. Non-empty unless declined.

overview.description: Two or three sentences. Non-empty unless declined.

cards.description: One entry per drawn card, keyed by its positionId, in input order. Kept with empty interpretations when declined.

synthesis.description: How the cards connect, ending on one concrete step. Non-empty unless declined.

reflectionPrompts.description: prompt1, prompt2, …: exactly the number given in <length>, open questions. Empty strings when declined.
